name: Exia Sight draws a card
notes: Exia Sight is an EXIA (advanced element) ACTION card, so the starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real EXIA champion (Dante, Hemomancer, reused from mend-flesh-damage25-recover). Its reserve cost is 0, so no reserve payment decisions are needed. Only the base 'Draw a card' is covered; the [Damage 20+] discount-for-next-card clause isn't reached (champion Damage is 0).
